analysis: The PR is documentation-only: docs/reference/configuration.md. It changes the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and appends a sentence to the MLX_QUANTIZED_CONSTANT_CACHE row (around base/head line 593), stating that a bf16 GPT-OSS checkpoint keeps bf16 activations, needs no widening, and so does not use this constant cache. No code, defaults, environment allow-lists, attestation, key custody, cache-encryption or coordinator-contract behavior changes. The wider head text is the unchanged surrounding config reference (SSD prefix cache, T-041 settings, App Attest worker opt-ins, endpoint resumption and logout), and I saw no security-relevant edits there. The patch excerpt is marked incomplete, but the range map is complete and lists only lines 3 and 593. The bf16 claim cannot be checked against the ConstantArrayCastCache or GPT-OSS source, which was not supplied. It is a performance or behavior description, not a security control. It does not touch the T-041 prefix-cache posture, TB-007 inference-engine isolation, or any other threat entry. No threat-model update is needed. No cross-file interactions were identified. No findings.
